question: 全校的诊改指标达标率是多少？
诊改任务完成率是多少？
各诊改层面的指标达标率分别是多少？
sql: SELECT level, ROUND(CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN status = '已达标' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL)/SUM(CASE WHEN status IN ('已达标','未达标','已逾期') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),4) FROM diag_tasks GROUP BY level ORDER BY level

question: 两个年度执行体系的任务完成率对比
sql: SELECT system_name, ROUND(CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN status IN ('已达标','未达标') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL)/COUNT(*),4) FROM diag_tasks GROUP BY system_name ORDER BY system_name

question: 2026 年度诊改的指标达标率是多少？
sql: SELECT ROUND(CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN status = '已达标' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL)/SUM(CASE WHEN status IN ('已达标','未达标','已逾期') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),4) FROM diag_tasks WHERE end_date >= '2026-01-01' AND end_date < '2027-01-01'
